description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welipathayaya, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in the Ratnapura District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and classifications, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
